components.name: Menu action
components.css: .ds-action { width: 300px; height: 58px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; background: rgb(58% 24% 7% / 98%); color: white; font: 21px sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: A sparse, low-poly road runs toward the horizon through a dark desert. Warm road lights, reflectors and vehicle lamps provide the visual punctuation; a translucent menu leaves the drive visible behind it.
keyCharacteristics: Three-lane road framed by guard rails and repeating lamps.
Dark, fogged scenery with warm emissive accents.
Screen-edge driving information and a left-side menu over the scene.

rules.name: The Warm Road Rule
rules.body: Use amber and gold to mark the road edges and lights against the dark scene.

dos: Do keep the road and lane markings legible against the desert at night.
Do use warm emissive accents for roadside guidance and vehicle lights.
Do keep driving status at the screen edges so the road remains visible.
donts: Don't add a jump action; steering between lanes is the intended movement.
